description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Thalawa, Thirappane, Palagala, Pradeshiya Sabhas has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of various Pradeshiya Sabhas due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about elected positions.
